story.title: Premium skincare, meticulously formulated.
story.body: Glow Verve is a premium skincare brand dedicated to illuminating your skin's true potential. Our serums are formulated with powerful, active ingredients designed to deliver visible results. Whether you're looking to brighten, hydrate, or rejuvenate, Glow Verve offers tailored solutions that fit seamlessly into your skincare routine.

regimen.title: Four steps to a considered glow.
regimen.body: Apply serums from thinnest to thickest texture, after cleansing and toning and before your moisturizer.
regimen.step_1_body: Start with a clean, toned face so actives can absorb evenly.
regimen.step_2_body: Press 2–3 drops of your Glow Verve serum onto face and neck.
regimen.step_3_body: Seal in hydration with a barrier-supporting cream.
regimen.step_4_body: Every morning, finish with a high-protection SPF.

pairing.title: Pairing guide
pairing.none: Plays well with the whole range.
pairing.vitamin_c_avoid: Keep strong acids and retinoids to a separate routine; alternate sessions.
pairing.retinol_avoid: Not with leave-on AHAs/BHAs or benzoyl peroxide in the same routine. Start 2–3× a week.
pairing.niacinamide_avoid: Pairs with vitamin C (AM) or retinol (PM). Separate from low-pH exfoliating acids.
pairing.snail_avoid: Patch test first if you are allergic to mollusks or shellfish.
pairing.note: Always patch test new products. Daily sunscreen is essential when using vitamin C or retinol.
pairing.rice_note: Contains fragrance; patch test if your skin is sensitive.
pairing.barrier_note: Contains salicylic acid; patch test first and stop if irritation occurs.
pairing.clarifying_note: Apply before moisturizer; follow with sunscreen in the daytime.
